Succ. 5ᵇ (expl. כרוב), v. כְּרוּב I; a. e.—Fem. רְבִיתָא girl.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 24:14">Targ. Y. Gen. XXIV, 14</cite> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="T00582"><he>ריבא</he></cite>). Targ. II Esth. II, 12, sq.; a. e.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b:9">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>הויא ההיא ר׳ וכ׳</he> there was a girl (in Sodom) that carried bread for the poor in a pitcher.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 58b:15">Ib. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ דפלניא</he> that slave’s girl (assigned to him as wife by his master).

<cite ref="Kiddushin 70b:10">Kidd. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>דלא אשתייר … ר׳ וכ׳</he> for none of them (the Asmonean family) survived except a certain girl &c.; a. e.—V. <cite ref="T00582"><he>רִיבָא</he></cite>.
